project_overview.project_summary: This data analytics / reporting project centers on Looker Studio BigQuery Migration. The formal job description is sparse, so the conversation and delivered artifacts are the primary evidence for reconstructing the engagement. The work sits mainly in Data analytics and reporting, Data Science & Analytics, Data Analysis & Testing. Stable project themes include data-source migration, dashboard continuity, report and metric validation. The available evidence includes 99 conversation messages, 2 deliverable files, which together document the brief, collaboration, review cycle, and delivered work. The recoverable artifacts span .pdf formats; their contents were used only where they supplied stable domain, production, architecture, or handoff information. For onboarding, the key task is to understand the intended audience, source assets, production workflow, review loop, delivery formats, and constraints that determine acceptance. No inspectable software repository was identified, so technical details are limited to what the brief, conversation, and artifacts explicitly establish.
project_overview.main_problem: Migrate existing dashboards to consolidated BigQuery data sources without breaking their intended metrics and reporting behavior.
project_overview.expected_outcome: Looker Studio dashboards connected to the approved BigQuery sources and checked for continuity after migration. The delivered context covers data-source migration, dashboard continuity, report and metric validation.
